newsitem.title: USA: Jostens to make New England Patriots' rings.
newsitem.headline: Jostens to make New England Patriots' rings.

text.p: Jostens Inc said Wednesday it was chosen to craft the rings that will mark the New England Patriots' recent American Football Conference championship.

It said Patriots' management contracted with Jostens to produce about 150 rings for players, coaches, team management and full-time employees. The company also will design a line of jewelry items for the Patriots' season ticket holders and fans.
Jostens produces class and sports rings, yearbooks and school photography.
